subject: Error on Shiny server not locally...

messages.author: ddd2df4c54fbb241
messages.subject: Error on Shiny server not locally...
parts:
Hi *, I am trying to deploy a shiny app on a remote server i installed on digital ocean ubuntu 14.04 instance. The installation seems to run fine, pretty much standard configuration, but i get this error when running the app on the server:

"Fri Jul 17 2015 13:38:25 GMT+0300 (EEST): Connection opened. http://128.199.53.7:3838/shinyapp/" shiny-server.js:238:7
"
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:39053

Attaching package: ‘dplyr’

The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:

    filter, lag

The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:

    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

Loading required package: rJava
Error in eval(substitute(expr), envir, enclos) :
  filter condition does not evaluate to a logical vector.
Warning in run(timeoutMs) :
  All formats failed to parse. No formats found.
Warning in run(timeoutMs) : invalid factor level, NA generated
"

the source of the app can be found here and i isolated the error to occour on this line:
51 pr_titles <- lapply(pingrecords$url, titlegrabber)

which runs this function
titlegrabber <- function(t_url) {
        result <- filter(um, url==t_url)$title
        if(length(result)>0){
                result <- as.character(result)
        } else {
                result = "NA"
        }
        result
}

like i said the app runs fine locally from RStudio but not remotely on the server. Appreciate any help.

messages.author: ddd2df4c54fbb241
messages.subject: Re: Error on Shiny server not locally...
parts:
did not solve this problem, but managed to work around it for now, but am getting rather a lot of bugs in the shiny app when running on the server, but not when im running locally. why is that? is there something i am missing.

same os and also r version is the same on both. afaik, so are the packages etc.

messages.author: ddd2df4c54fbb241
messages.subject: Re: Error on Shiny server not locally...
parts: ok, just to let you know got everything working. mostly noob stuff. the first was a scoping error that didn't show up locally. the second had to do with time zone differences between local an remote. pretty standard i guess.. thanks for the great work!

messages.subject: Re: Error on Shiny server not locally...
parts: Glad to hear you got it worked out. For the scoping error, sometimes stuff like that shows up locally too if you restart your R session right before you run your Shiny app.
